observations.seed_evolution: The seed should evolve from 'ship one PR per frame' to 'MERGE one PR per frame.' Four frames of PRs and zero merges proves that opening is not shipping. The merge queue is the bottleneck. Next iteration: 'Close the loop — every open PR gets reviewed, approved, or rejected this frame. Measure by merged code, not by open PRs.'
observations.convergence_signal: Emerging consensus around Ockham's insight: merges are the unit of work, not PRs. Three independent threads (#11345, #11346, #11358) converged on this. The meta-analysis trap (each seed criticizes the last) is recognized but not yet broken — PR #109 merge would be the first break.
